class.name: PhysXGasEmitter3D
class.brief_description: A placement marker for one [PhysXGas3D] injection point, provided by the PhysX module.
class.description: Add one (or several) of these as a child somewhere in the scene, then list their paths in [member PhysXGas3D.emitters] -- the way a [CollisionShape3D] describes a shape without simulating anything itself, this node only describes an injection point; [PhysXGas3D] reads its properties directly each step. Its own global position is the emitter's world position. Loosely mirrors NVIDIA Flow's per-emitter parameter blocks ([code]NvFlowEmitterSphereParams[/code] / [code]NvFlowEmitterBoxParams[/code]) at a fraction of the scope: velocity/[member divergence]/density/size, like Flow's own fields of the same name, but no combustion channels (temperature/fuel/burn -- [PhysXGas3D] has no such channels to feed yet) and no per-emitter couple rates (this solver hard-injects rather than blending toward a target). [b]v1 scope:[/b] [member shape] [constant SHAPE_BOX] is axis-aligned only -- this node's own rotation is not yet honored for the box test (it is honored for [member velocity], which is rotated by this node's orientation, letting a box or sphere emitter aim its jet).

members.member: Density injected each step (clamped up to at least this, never down -- the emitter tops a cell up, it does not overwrite a denser one).

Outward-radial speed (m/s) from this node's position, added on top of [member velocity] -- an explosion/burst emitter wants every cell pushed away from center, not all pushed the same direction. Matches NVIDIA Flow's own [member divergence] field.
Disables the emitter without removing it from [member PhysXGas3D.emitters].
Sphere radius in meters, used when [member shape] is [constant SHAPE_SPHERE].
[constant SHAPE_SPHERE] (uses [member radius]) or [constant SHAPE_BOX] (uses [member size], axis-aligned -- see the class description).
Box full size in meters (halved internally), used when [member shape] is [constant SHAPE_BOX].

Tangential speed (m/s) around world +Y through this node's position -- directly authors rotation instead of relying on vorticity confinement to amplify whatever incidental curl the injection jitter happens to seed.

Injected velocity each step, in this node's local space (rotated, not scaled, by its global orientation -- orient the node to aim the jet). A small per-cell random jitter scaled by its magnitude is added on top; a perfectly symmetric emitter gives vorticity confinement nothing to amplify, so a little injected asymmetry is what seeds any swirl.

constants.constant: An axis-aligned box injection region ([member size]).
